_comment: Manual curation applied on top of Goodreads imports. 'exclude' ids are on the Goodreads shelf but deliberately not on the site; import-goodreads.js drops them on every re-import. 'fields' pins hand-fixed values per id (titles, series) that would otherwise be overwritten by the scraped Goodreads values; they are re-applied on every import and by --sort. Manual site-only entries (books absent from the shelf export) are preserved automatically.
